Answer "supported" only if the sentences state that South District Zone Controller produces or sends this item AND that North District Zone Controller receives or uses the same item (it may be named more briefly in one sentence). response: {"verdict":"unsupported","reason":"S029 identifies both district zone controllers as sources of movement authority data received onboard, not South District Zone Controller as a sender to North District Zone Controller."}
